checks.detail: T3 TaskSpec envelope binds allowed_files (ticket receipt, validation receipt, two independent reviews, task report, completion receipt, campaign_adapters.py, test_control_plane_campaign_adapters.py), forbids all production campaign/control-plane files, data/KBase, scheduler/ACL, and user files; payload_sha256 matches canonical serialization.

All eight input evidence references hash-match the live repository: P6 approval, scope manifest, implementation baseline, T1 task report, T1 validation receipt, T1 completion receipt, T2 task report, and T2 completion receipt; baseline_sha256 matches implementation_baseline.json.

The only tracked additions beyond the four protected user files are research_automation/control_plane/campaign_adapters.py and tests/test_control_plane_campaign_adapters.py; the diff does not modify campaign.py, stores.py, task_reports.py, contracts.py, requirements, policy, data, or any forbidden file.

normalize_usage returns REPORTED when token/cost usage is present, ESTIMATED only for an explicit ESTIMATED hint or estimated=True flag, and UNKNOWN with all-null fields otherwise; malformed tokens/costs become null; total_tokens is never below the component sum; cost accepts str/int/float/Decimal and rejects non-finite values.

CallableProviderAdapter and RetryDisabledClientAdapter are single-call boundaries; RetryDisabledClientAdapter fails closed on positive client.max_retries; RetryPolicy/build_retrying_invocation delegate logical retry ownership to RetryingModelInvocation with bounds 1..100 attempts and positive wall time.

p7_authorized=false, campaign_authorized=false, final_holdout_authorized=false, auto_advance=false; no real data/KBase read, no scheduler/ACL mutation, no daily update/backtest/research/campaign/holdout started; no provider SDK import or network I/O.

advisories.detail: ProviderResponseNormalizer keeps the original raw_usage mapping in ProviderResponse so the campaign snapshot keeps its canonical raw-usage hash; normalized token/cost values are re-derived by campaign._snapshot_provider_response. This is intentional layering, not a defect.

Mapping payloads carrying usage_status as a plain string (for example "ESTIMATED") are not treated as an ESTIMATED hint; only the UsageStatus enum or estimated=True selects ESTIMATED. The documented adapter contract uses the enum, so this is a conservative fail-closed choice.
